name: Global Infrastructure Reporting and Analysis: one morning read that declares whether anything needs Andrew, across every Opal property (third-member naming at Andrew; PRD s.6), with instrument state separable from world state and every number carrying its coverage.
description: Replace a miscalibrated daily infrastructure report with one whose rows can be trusted. Twelve ratified outcomes: a declarative morning verdict; a vocabulary that separates 'nobody looked' from 'we looked and here is how bad'; per-row deltas; property+owner attribution; whether an alert would reach a human before an incident tests it; broken-vs-retired on consumer evidence rather than age; retirement on the record; cost movement that matters; one compute record spanning EC2 and ECS; counts that carry their denominators; what we publish that nothing watches; and, on an anomaly, the connected resources plus an analysis bounded by C-AI. Andrew-direct commissioning 2026-09-09: 'it has been miscalibrated for a long time and it's time that we fixed that.'

TWO CARRIED FACTS THE DECOMPOSITION MUST NOT LOSE: (1) FWD-2 is the CRITICAL PATH into the NFRA_OPSEC202609 relationship -- until the report can express BLIND, DEGRADED and DESIRED-not-APPLIED, it cannot honestly render ANY OPSEC surface, and every gap becomes either a false OK or a false alarm. (2) The Website property's security row is settled PERMANENTLY, not pending: NFRA_OPSEC202609 C-19 establishes there is no AWS-only route to an edge for opalinvest.com, so that row renders BLIND with its reason attached forever and does NOT wait on TO-OP-S-13. (3) ADDED AT L5 BY THE BATTERY: the ratified Axis-1 enum expresses NEITHER of the two states S1's own bound column requires -- there is no value for a PERMANENT blind and none for DESIRED-not-APPLIED (INERT is closest and still wrong, since INERT means a control that CANNOT FIRE while the sentinel CAN and is deliberately watch-only). Resolved additively (a rejectable resolvable field; a third orthogonal desired|applied|exercised axis) so ruling 12's value set is untouched; if either is read as AMENDING that ruling it is NOT the COO lane's to make. (4) ADDED AT L5: comp-schedule G-7 measures FIVE files sharing the basename lib/trading_calendar.py, so RP-s-3 must name the trading-day frontier BY RESOLVED PATH -- a cell resolving the wrong copy passes its own check and still sends on a market holiday. (5) ADDED AT L5: comp-iam does NOT model wafv2, the plane C-SENTINEL-STATE lives on, so comp-iam silence is never evidence about the sentinel's enforcement path. (6) ADDED AT ROUND 3 PREP BY L6 RULING (1.0.0_SA_CTO~Z msg 20822, row NFRA_REPORT-Z-S12 @73ffb25e28, dispositioning W1-S5 DISMISSED_WITH_REASON as an outside remedy under spine 2.4): EVERY ROUND-3 WORKER FACE MUST CARRY the instruction that any census or absence claim is run from the MAIN ajb_workspace checkout, NEVER from the worker's own linked worktree, and that a comp-find/comp-read/comp-which ZERO obtained inside a worktree is NOT evidence of absence. The comp-rail resolves its corpus from the TOOL SCRIPT'S own on-disk location (~/bin/comp-find:16 hardcodes the main-tree path; _comprail.repo_root() runs with cwd=_HERE), so rule 14b's mandated worktree and rule 21's default instrument combine into a silent GRAIN mismatch that prints a MEASURED denominator over the wrong tree. The hazard is LIVE AT HEAD and UNOWNED -- nothing is fixed, and this worker-face clause is the only thing protecting this project from it. Corroborated on a second arm and a different project: comp-find from a linked worktree returned 0 hits against a real 173-file denominator for a token returning 8 from the main tree.
